| # | Date | Part | Topic |
|--:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Wed 23/09 | [Intro]{.part .part-gen} [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Course overview, logistics and exam. Receding horizon, nominal MPC and its properties, MPC pseudo-code and notation |
| 2 | Thu 24/09 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Toy example vs PID, general formulation, infinite-horizon control, LQR and its optimal cost |
| 3 | Mon 28/09 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Dual-mode control and implications for MPC; numerical experiment |
| 4 | Wed 30/09 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Case study: control of an EV charging area (formulation and Julia code) |
| 5 | Thu 01/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | End of case study; value function interpretation, Bellman's principle, explicit MPC |
| 6 | Mon 05/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Recursive feasibility; stability and Lyapunov theory |
| 7 | Wed 07/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Stability of tracking MPC |
| 8 | Thu 08/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Economic MPC; large-scale EV charging control |
| 9 | Mon 12/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Large-scale EV charging: battery losses, decentralized strategies |
| 10 | Wed 14/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Building energy management with MPC: model and constraints |
| 11 | Thu 15/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Building energy management: objective function and results |
| 12 | Mon 19/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Task scheduling in an assembly line; logical constraints |
| 13 | Wed 21/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | End of task scheduling; MPC for traffic control |
| 14 | Thu 22/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Exercises; unmeasured states and offset-free MPC |
| 15 | Mon 26/10 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | From MPC to dynamic programming; introduction to RL |
| 16 | Wed 28/10 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | MDPs, value functions, Bellman equations |
| 17 | Thu 29/10 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Dynamic programming: policy and value iteration; numerical experiment |
| 18 | Mon 02/11 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Monte Carlo and temporal-difference methods; Q-learning |
| 19 | Wed 04/11 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Function approximation and deep RL (DDPG) |
| 20 | Thu 05/11 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Hybrid MPC–RL algorithms |
| 21 | Mon 09/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Introduction to identification; statistical estimators and their properties |
| 22 | Wed 11/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Linear and weighted least squares; regularization |
| 23 | Thu 12/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Maximum likelihood, Bayesian estimation, Cramér–Rao bound, nonlinear least squares |
| 24 | Mon 16/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Recursive least squares; dynamic models (ARX, output error), predictors |
| 25 | Wed 18/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Prediction error methods; experiment design; model validation |
| 26 | Thu 19/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Lab: full identification workflow on real data |
| 27 | Mon 23/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Kalman filter, EKF, moving horizon estimation |
| 28 | Wed 25/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Data-driven predictive control: Willems' lemma and DeePC |
| 29 | Thu 26/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Time series for forecasting; advanced identification methods |
| 30 | Mon 30/11 | [Wrap-up]{.part .part-gen} | Course recap, exam information, identify-then-control demo |
